```sql
WITH lines AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT pv.product_id,
           ol.order_id,
           pv.id AS variant_id,
           ol.quantity,
           ol.line_total_cents
      FROM order_lines ol
      JOIN orders o            ON o.id = ol.order_id
      JOIN product_variants pv ON pv.id = ol.variant_id::uuid
     WHERE o.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s
       AND o.created_at >= %(from)s
       AND o.created_at <  %(to)s
       AND o.status IN ('paid', 'processing', 'shipped', 'delivered')
),
per_order AS (
    SELECT product_id,
           order_id,
           sum(quantity)         AS qty,
           sum(line_total_cents) AS rev
      FROM lines
     GROUP BY product_id, order_id
),
prod_agg AS (
    SELECT product_id,
           count(*)          AS order_count,
           sum(qty)::bigint  AS quantity,
           sum(rev)          AS revenue_cents
      FROM per_order
     GROUP BY product_id
),
var_agg AS (
    SELECT product_id, count(*) AS variant_count
      FROM (SELECT DISTINCT product_id, variant_id FROM lines) d
     GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT p.id,
       p.sku,
       p.name,
       p.brand,
       p.currency,
       a.order_count,
       a.quantity,
       a.revenue_cents,
       v.variant_count
  FROM prod_agg a
  JOIN var_agg v  ON v.product_id = a.product_id
  JOIN products p ON p.id = a.product_id
 ORDER BY a.quantity DESC, a.revenue_cents DESC
 LIMIT %(limit)s
```

Het origineel spilt naar schijf. Dat komt door een brede sort op (p.id, o.id), nodig voor de twee `count(DISTINCT ...)` en de GroupAggregate. Die vervang ik door smalle hash-aggregaties in twee niveaus: eerst per (product, order) en daarna per product, met een aparte DISTINCT per (product, variant). Pas daarna join ik de 4000 productrijen; de cast naar `bigint` houdt het kolomtype van `quantity` gelijk aan het origineel en `revenue_cents` blijft `numeric`.
